scope: One Vfs::handle_path mount-prefix repair, docs and regression test; inherited architecture findings are not closed

delta.locks: No new lock/IPC/callback; existing caller VFS lock covers lookup/join
delta.progress: Bounded8 mount validation and bounded256 local buffer; no recursion or new retries
delta.authority: No capability, credential, namespace or mount-admission changes
delta.ownership: Owned local String; capacity checked before caller copy; backend buffer remains stack-local
delta.ABI: No wire/C/Rust public structure or syscall-number changes

findings.finding: No component ancestor Execute permission policy common to stat/chdir/read operations; required before authoritative realpath
fstat copies fd backend handle under scheduler then releases before VFS; generation prevents ordinary reuse but no in-flight descriptor pin; concurrent close/full generation wrap not forced
Service VFS is a different namespace; passwd/group FSTAT path round trip is weaker than actual opened-descriptor identity
Concurrent rename/mount mutation, FAT stale-name behavior, path cache invalidation and non-root permission failures not guest-qualified

TOCTOU: Path lookup results can change after lock release. tmpfs unlink retains fd inode, but path reconstruction then fails. Directory paging is not snapshot atomic. No new security boundary is claimed.
broader_changes: Deferred: backend identity/time/symlink storage, one credential-aware resolver with bounded traversal, versioned metadata ABI and in-flight descriptor ownership. No scheduler/IPC redesign performed.
